verdict.rationale: Fly.io's docs describe org-wide secret connections, granular access grants (by Sprite/label/endpoint), and one-click credential rotation across the whole org (fly-io-docs-11, fly-io-docs-12, fly-io-docs-13), which supports centralized secrets/access management. However, this is framed around 'Sprites' (agent sandboxes) rather than classic team-member/role management or explicit env-var CLI tooling, and there's no evidence of user/team invite or RBAC docs. missing for 10: team-member/role management docs, explicit env-var (fly secrets set) CLI walkthrough, independent confirmation of these access controls in production use.
